from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import hashlib
import importlib
import json
import symtable
import sys
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
BACKEND = ROOT / "backend"
sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND))
sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND / "scripts"))
from verify_backend_quality_budgets import measure_source

OUT = ROOT / "docs/audit/dashboard-2026-10-30"
PREFIX = "app.presentation.api.v1.routes.passport_routes."
DIR = BACKEND / "app/presentation/api/v1/routes/passport_routes"
OWNERS = {
    "_no_store": "contact_challenges",
    "_locked_upload": "contact_challenges",
    "_locked_challenge": "contact_challenges",
    "request_public_contact_otp": "contact_issuance",
    "verify_public_contact_otp": "contact_completion",
    "require_public_contact_proof": "contact_submission_proof",
    "require_verified_family_head": "contact_family",
}


def digest(value: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()


def node_map(source: str) -> dict:
    return {node.name: node for node in ast.parse(source).body if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))}


def source_segment(source: str, node: ast.AST) -> str:
    start = min([node.lineno, *[decorator.lineno for decorator in node.decorator_list]])
    return "\n".join(source.splitlines()[start - 1:node.end_lineno])


original = json.loads((OUT / "contact-verification-original-source.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
old_source = original["source"]
assert digest(old_source.encode()) == original["sha256"]
old_nodes = node_map(old_source)
assert set(old_nodes) == set(OWNERS)
facade = importlib.import_module(PREFIX + "contact_verification")
old_globals = {"__name__": PREFIX + "contact_verification", "__package__": PREFIX.rstrip(".")}
# Import and register the captured original's in-memory router only. No endpoint,
# settings lookup, provider, database, or application lifespan is executed.
exec(compile(old_source, original["path"], "exec"), old_globals)
old_symbols = {entry.get_name(): entry for entry in symtable.symtable(old_source, original["path"], "exec").get_children()}
movements = []
for name, owner in OWNERS.items():
    module = importlib.import_module(PREFIX + owner)
    owner_path = DIR / f"{owner}.py"
    current = owner_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    current_node = node_map(current)[name]
    assert ast.dump(current_node, include_attributes=False) == ast.dump(old_nodes[name], include_attributes=False)
    assert source_segment(current, current_node) == source_segment(old_source, old_nodes[name])
    actual = getattr(module, name)
    assert getattr(facade, name) is actual
    assert actual.__module__ == PREFIX + owner
    globals_proof = []
    for symbol in old_symbols[name].get_symbols():
        global_name = symbol.get_name()
        if not symbol.is_global() or not symbol.is_referenced() or global_name not in old_globals:
            continue
        if global_name in OWNERS:
            assert actual.__globals__[global_name] is getattr(facade, global_name)
            kind = "direct typed owner function with exact original body"
        elif global_name == "logger":
            assert owner == "contact_issuance"
            assignments = [node for node in ast.parse(current).body if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "logger" for target in node.targets)]
            assert len(assignments) == 1
            assert ast.dump(assignments[0].value) == ast.dump(ast.parse(f'get_logger("{PREFIX}contact_verification")').body[0].value)
            assert actual.__globals__["get_logger"] is old_globals["get_logger"]
            kind = "same logger factory and original channel"
        else:
            assert actual.__globals__[global_name] is old_globals[global_name], (name, global_name)
            kind = "same runtime dependency object"
        globals_proof.append({"name": global_name, "proof": kind})
    movements.append({"function": name, "owner": str(owner_path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"), "whole_decorated_function_ast_equal": True, "whole_decorated_function_lf_source_equal": True, "facade_alias_identity": True, "globals": globals_proof})

# Reject accidental duplication, lost bodies, and cycle-through-facade imports.
all_functions = []
for owner in set(OWNERS.values()):
    owner_source = (DIR / f"{owner}.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    all_functions.extend(node_map(owner_source))
    for node in ast.parse(owner_source).body:
        assert not (isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.level and node.module == "contact_verification")
assert sorted(all_functions) == sorted(OWNERS)
assert [(route.name, route.endpoint) for route in facade.router.routes] == [
    ("request_public_contact_otp", facade.request_public_contact_otp),
    ("verify_public_contact_otp", facade.verify_public_contact_otp),
]
submission_contact = importlib.import_module(PREFIX + "submission_contact")
assert submission_contact.require_public_contact_proof is facade.require_public_contact_proof
assert submission_contact.require_verified_family_head is facade.require_verified_family_head

old_tests = node_map(original["test_source"])
controlled_test = json.loads((OUT / "contact-verification-control-baseline-test-source.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["source"]
current_test_path = BACKEND / "tests/unit/presentation/test_public_upload_contact_otp.py"
new_test_source = current_test_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
new_tests = node_map(new_test_source)
controls = node_map(controlled_test)
assert set(new_tests) == set(controls)
test_proof = []
for name, old in old_tests.items():
    if name == "rig":
        expected = source_segment(original["test_source"], old)
        for dependency in ["ClientGroupRepository", "PassportSubmissionRepository"]:
            expected = expected.replace(f'monkeypatch.setattr(routes, "{dependency}",', f'monkeypatch.setattr(contact_challenges, "{dependency}",')
        for dependency in ["get_settings", "get_otp_provider", "PublicUploadOTPRateLimiter"]:
            expected = expected.replace(f'monkeypatch.setattr(routes, "{dependency}",', f'monkeypatch.setattr(contact_issuance, "{dependency}",')
        assert expected == source_segment(new_test_source, new_tests[name])
        scope = "only five dependency-patch owners retargeted; remaining fixture exact"
    else:
        assert source_segment(original["test_source"], old) == source_segment(new_test_source, new_tests[name])
        assert ast.dump(old) == ast.dump(new_tests[name])
        scope = "whole decorated original helper/test exact in source and AST"
    test_proof.append({"name": name, "scope": scope})
new_names = set(controls) - set(old_tests)
assert new_names == {"test_provider_success_cannot_authorize_a_changed_upload_or_challenge"}
for name in new_names:
    assert source_segment(controlled_test, controls[name]) == source_segment(new_test_source, new_tests[name])
old_assertions = [ast.dump(node) for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(original["test_source"])) if isinstance(node, ast.Assert)]
new_assertions = [ast.dump(node) for name, node in new_tests.items() if name in old_tests for node in ast.walk(node) if isinstance(node, ast.Assert)]
assert sorted(old_assertions) == sorted(new_assertions)

paths = sorted({DIR / f"{owner}.py" for owner in OWNERS.values()} | {DIR / "contact_verification.py", current_test_path})
bound_sources = [{"path": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"), "sha256": digest(path.read_bytes()), "lines": len(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines())} for path in paths]
proof = {"original_sha256": original["sha256"], "function_movements": movements, "function_count": len(movements), "complete_original_test_functions": test_proof, "original_assertion_count": len(old_assertions), "original_assertions_unchanged": True, "new_control_cases": 2, "new_control_source_equal_to_before_refactor": True, "no_lost_or_duplicate_functions": True, "no_owner_imports_facade": True, "runtime_routes_use_actual_owner_functions": True, "submission_contact_imports_actual_gates": True, "signature_normalization": "Only get_db_session's inspect repr process address; raw original/current snapshots retained. OpenAPI, evaluated type hints, route metadata and all other signature bytes compare exactly.", "bound_sources": bound_sources}
(OUT / "contact-verification-extraction-proof.json").write_text(json.dumps(proof, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
measured = [asdict(measure_source(path, str(path.relative_to(BACKEND)).replace("\\", "/"))) for path in paths if path.parent == DIR]
budget_document = json.loads((BACKEND / "backend_quality_budgets.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
existing = {item["path"]: item for item in budget_document["modules"]}
coverage_gates = [item for items in budget_document["coverage_gates"].values() if isinstance(items, list) for item in items if "contact_verification.py" in item["path"]]
candidate = {"shared_budget_file_edited": False, "measurements": measured, "prior_size_budgets": {item["path"]: existing.get(item["path"]) for item in measured}, "existing_original_coverage_gates": coverage_gates, "proposed_coverage_floors": [{"path": item["path"], "minimum_line_percent": 95, "minimum_branch_percent": 92} for item in measured], "candidates": [{"path": item["path"], "baseline_lines": item["lines"], "maximum_lines": item["lines"], "baseline_max_function_complexity": item["max_function_complexity"], "maximum_function_complexity": item["max_function_complexity"], "minimum_coverage_percent": 95} for item in measured]}
(OUT / "contact-verification-budget-candidates.json").write_text(json.dumps(candidate, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"functions_exact": len(movements), "global_bindings_proved": sum(len(item["globals"]) for item in movements), "original_test_or_helper_functions": len(test_proof), "original_assertions_unchanged": len(old_assertions), "measurements": measured}, indent=2))
